about_text: ISITAN was founded in 1959 in a small workshop in Bursa, Turkey, building beading and plate-rolling machines for tinsmiths. Through the 1970s the range grew to larger pyramid plate rolls, circular cutting shears and flanging machines, and the company began exporting in 1996. Today ISITAN builds in two factories with about 160 employees: 3- and 4-roll plate rolls, bead rollers, circle cutting machines, CNC, NC and rotary draw tube and profile benders, pipe notchers, pipe-end forming machines and circular cold saws — CE certified and built with European components.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports ISITAN machines in Canada from Mississauga, ON — the machine matched to your material and sizes, a CSA-approved panel, operator training, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
